clauses.heading: Service Line > Definitions
clauses.text: “Service line” means exterior underground piping and wiring, including connected valves and fittings, that provides water, sewer, electrical, natural gas or telecommunications service to the dwelling on the “residence premises”, that is owned by an “insured” or that an “insured” is responsible for, and that is located on the “residence premises”. It does not include piping or wiring that is not connected to a system in use, septic tanks or leach fields, irrigation or sprinkler systems, or any line owned by a utility.

clauses.heading: Service Line > Definitions
clauses.text: “Service line failure” means a leak, break, tear, rupture, collapse or electrical arcing of a “service line” caused by wear and tear, deterioration, rust or corrosion, mechanical breakdown, freezing, the invasion of tree roots, or the weight of vehicles, equipment, animals or people.

clauses.heading: Service Line > Coverage
clauses.text: We will pay for direct physical damage to a “service line” caused by a “service line failure”, including the necessary cost to excavate and replace it and to repair outdoor property damaged by the excavation, up to $10,000 in any one loss. The exclusions of loss caused by wear and tear, mechanical breakdown and corrosion in paragraphs 2.g.1 through 2.g.3 of Section I - Perils Insured Against do not apply to this coverage. A deductible of $500 applies in place of the Section I deductible.

clauses.heading: Service Line > Not Covered
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by earth movement, flood or any other cause excluded in Section I - Exclusions; damage caused by excavation work done by an “insured” or by anyone on an “insured's” behalf; the cost to clear a blockage that has not damaged the “service line”; or any fine or penalty.
